info.title: Unit Converter API
info.description: Stateless measurement conversions for length, weight, temperature, area, and volume. Unit IDs are case-sensitive. Volume measures labeled US use US customary definitions. Send numeric input as a string using a dot decimal separator and optional exponent, without grouping. Numeric result fields are strings so clients can preserve decimal precision. No authentication is required.

get.summary: List conversion categories and supported units

200.description: The available categories, default unit pairs, and public unit definitions.

post.description: Length, weight, area, and volume must be nonnegative. Temperatures must be at or above absolute zero. Input must be exactly representable as a .NET decimal (up to 28 decimal places and 29 significant digits, magnitude at most 79228162514264337593543950335). Results outside the decimal range, including underflow to zero, produce a validation error. Fixed display precision uses midpoint rounding away from zero. Nonzero results that would display as zero use scientific notation with six significant digits.

200.description: The calculated value and its display representation. inputValue and value are exact decimal strings; formattedValue is intended for display and may be rounded.

400.description: Invalid JSON, missing fields, an invalid category or unit, invalid numeric syntax or precision, an impossible measurement, or a result outside the decimal range. errors uses PascalCase keys: Category, From, To, Value, Precision, or Body.

Value: Temperature cannot be below absolute zero (−273.15 °C, −459.67 °F, or 0 K).

415.description: The request Content-Type is not application/json or a compatible +json media type.

example.title: Unsupported media type.
example.detail: Send the request with Content-Type: application/json.

Body: A JSON request body is required.

from.description: A source unit ID from the selected category.

to.description: A destination unit ID from the same category.

value.description: Invariant numeric input, using a dot decimal separator and optional exponent; no grouping separators.

precision.description: Maximum fixed decimal places in formattedValue. Tiny nonzero values use six-significant-digit scientific notation.

inputValue.description: Parsed input as an invariant decimal string, possibly using exponent notation.

value.description: Computed decimal value without display rounding, as an invariant numeric string. Nonterminating ratios are rounded to decimal precision.

formattedValue.description: Display result with requested fixed precision, or scientific notation for tiny nonzero values.

inputText.description: Original input with surrounding whitespace removed.

isRounded.description: Whether the displayed result differs from the exact rational conversion.
